transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this selection process discussion. As Director of Talent, I'll be overseeing the panel appointment and assessment process for the vacant team-lead role. I'd like to start by hearing from each of you about any process or relationship considerations I should be aware of as we move forward. Let's begin with the hiring manager, then move to the peer manager, HR, and finally the employee representative. Who would like to start?

transcript.text:
Thank you all for these important disclosures. Let me address each one in turn.

First, Marcus — thank you for putting Rina's relationship with Jonah on the record. Given that Rina is Jonah's close personal friend and has been informally coaching him, I will not appoint Rina to the interview panel. That conflict is clear and must be avoided to maintain the integrity of the process.

Second, Sofia — thank you for flagging the procedural requirements. I will ensure the selection packet is updated to specify a standardized question set and individual written score sheets from every panelist before evaluations proceed.

Third, Tariq — thank you for raising Mara's accessibility needs. Per our accessibility practice, once a candidate's needs are raised through the employee representative, they must be implemented. Mara will receive the interview questions at least 48 hours in advance and will be permitted to submit written responses. This does not compromise equal treatment — it ensures equivalent opportunity to demonstrate the leadership criteria, even though her interview format will differ from Jonah's.

I also note that Priya's input was not captured clearly. Priya, could you please restate your consideration so I can record it properly in the selection log?

Before I finalize the panel appointment, I want to confirm my proposed approach: the panel will consist of three members drawn from the remaining available panelists — Elliot, Sofia, and Tariq — excluding Rina due to the disclosed conflict. Does anyone have additional process or relationship considerations I should record before I proceed?
